description: This file defines an abstract class 'Operation' for managing database operations within the Hive ThriftServer, including lifecycle management, logging, configuration, and execution control.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: An abstract class representing a database operation in Hive ThriftServer, managing lifecycle, configuration, logging, and execution.

methods.name: getBackgroundHandle
methods.description: Returns the Future handle for background execution.

methods.name: setBackgroundHandle
methods.description: Sets the Future handle for background execution.

methods.name: shouldRunAsync
methods.description: Indicates if the operation should run asynchronously.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the HiveConf configuration for the operation.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current HiveConf configuration.

methods.name: getParentSession
methods.description: Returns the parent HiveSession.

methods.name: getHandle
methods.description: Returns the OperationHandle.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the protocol version.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of operation.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the operation.

methods.name: hasResultSet
methods.description: Indicates if the operation produces a result set.

methods.name: setHasResultSet
methods.description: Sets whether the operation has a result set.

methods.name: getOperationLog
methods.description: Returns the operation log.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the operation's state with validation.

methods.name: isTimedOut
methods.description: Checks if the operation has timed out based on current time.

methods.name: getLastAccessTime
methods.description: Returns the last access timestamp.

methods.name: getOperationTimeout
methods.description: Returns the operation timeout setting.

methods.name: setOperationTimeout
methods.description: Sets the operation timeout.

methods.name: setOperationException
methods.description: Sets an exception related to the operation.

methods.name: assertState
methods.description: Asserts the operation is in a specific state.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the operation is running.

methods.name: isFinished
methods.description: Checks if the operation is finished.

methods.name: isCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the operation is canceled.

methods.name: isFailed
methods.description: Checks if the operation has failed.

methods.name: createOperationLog
methods.description: Creates an operation log file and object if logging is enabled.

methods.name: unregisterOperationLog
methods.description: Removes the current operation log from thread context.

methods.name: beforeRun
methods.description: Hook invoked before runInternal to set up preconditions.

methods.name: afterRun
methods.description: Hook invoked after runInternal to clean up.

methods.name: runInternal
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the specific operation logic.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the operation with setup and cleanup.

methods.name: cleanupOperationLog
methods.description: Closes the operation log if enabled.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the operation; default throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the operation and cleans up logs.

methods.name: getResultSetSchema
methods.description: Abstract method to get the result set schema.

methods.name: getNextRowSet
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch the next row set.

methods.name: validateDefaultFetchOrientation
methods.description: Validates if the fetch orientation is default supported.

methods.name: validateFetchOrientation
methods.description: Validates if the fetch orientation is supported.

methods.name: toSQLException
methods.description: Converts a CommandProcessorResponse to HiveSQLException.

methods.name: getConfOverlay
methods.description: Returns the configuration overlay map.
